endgames.method: Khianat plays the strong side against a random legal defence and has to deliver mate within the given number of moves. Every position appears twice, once with White and once with Black to move, so the test does not favour one colour. A random defender is weak on purpose: an engine with working technique mates it easily, an engine without one shuffles until the limit.
